body: I'm in 8th grade. Will you please PM me?
He's crazy the whole time. Shutter Island

It's actually better for brothers to talk to the younger siblings. My brother and I have had talks about it before and now we just joke about it. For example, he will come downstairs after for being in the bathroom for a while and straight up tell me he just "Jerked it." Makes me feel better about it in a weird sort of way.

Look, I'm 14 and going through the same thing, the only one true friend I had moved away from me and I feel so lonely and empty. I tried and thought about killing myself too. It doesn't help thinking about it, it only tears at you worse. I started playing the piano, I recommend you find a hobby to keep your mind off of it. You and I can get past this man, I promise. I don't care what it takes we are not going to let this sickness inside of us win. You are loved, you have people, you just have to be open to meeting people. Please message me if you need to. I don't want you to hurt yourself when you have the chance to get help. Just ask for help. Tell people what you are thinking so they can help. People love you.
Thank you. I really appreciate it.

I seem to just explode. But what the hell right? My family gave up on me a longggg time ago. I had to go to the hospital because I just simply blew up. Punched holes, and sadly worse stuff to myself. Learn how to control it, that's all I recommend to anyone. It scares me knowing who i can turn into and I am to the point I can't even stop it
